Application Data.NAME: Quick Stop Convenience
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Quick Stop Convenience is a retail operation specializing in the sale of convenience items, including snacks, beverages, groceries, and household essentials. The store operates daily from 6 AM to 11 PM and offers a variety of services such as lottery ticket sales, ATM access, and a selection of locally-sourced products. We prioritize customer service and maintain a clean, safe environment for our patrons. Regular staff training is conducted to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2022, a slip and fall incident occurred when a customer slipped on a wet floor that had not been properly marked. The claim was settled for $2,500 and is marked as closed. Additionally, on 08/20/2022, a theft incident involving the loss of merchandise valued at $700 was reported. The claim is currently open, with investigations ongoing.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around property perimeter, 24-hour monitored alarm system, and a dedicated night watchperson during closed hours.
